Private Bartending Services in Buffalo NY

Hammerl Bar Co. is a professional private bartending company serving Buffalo and Western New York, providing ATAP-certified, experienced bartenders and full-service bar setup for weddings, corporate events, tailgates, and private parties.

Our team manages setup, service, and breakdown from start to finish — bringing polish, consistency, and hospitality to every event we staff, so you can focus on your guests.

Polished, reliable bar service with custom cocktail menus tailored to your reception.

Private Parties

From tailgates to house parties and milestone celebrations, we bring the bartender, tools, ice, and mixers directly to you.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you provide the alcohol?

No — you always supply the alcohol. Mixers and fresh garnishes are included with our Full Bar Package, or you're welcome to bring your own with any other package.

What's included with a bartender booking?

Every package includes an ATAP-certified, experienced bartender, bar tools, full event setup, and breakdown/cleanup. Our Bartender & Bar Supplies package adds ice, coolers, disposable cups, napkins, and straws. Our Full Bar Package goes a step further and includes mixers and fresh garnishes too.

Do you offer a mobile bar?

Yes. Our mobile bar can be rented alongside any bartending package for a polished, dedicated serving station — delivered and set up on-site.

Is there a minimum for events?

All events have a 3-hour, 20-person minimum. Additional bartenders can be added for $50/hr as needed for larger guest counts.

How do I get exact pricing for my event?

Book now with your event details and we'll send a full, exact breakdown within 24 hours.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Buffalo and Western New York for weddings, corporate events, tailgates, and private parties.
